title: First steps with AutoDiag: doctor and demo
keywords: autodiag getting started first steps quick start doctor demo try example smoke test
text: dds-autodiag doctor checks the prerequisites (ROS 2 sourced, CLI available, network) and prints fixes. dds-autodiag demo starts two deliberately broken topics under /autodiag_demo/ (a reliability mismatch and latched data with a volatile subscriber), diagnoses them and keeps them running so you can explore them in the dashboard or RViz; Ctrl+C stops them, and --no-wait exits right after the diagnosis. The demo never touches your own topics.
